comment: Catalog of tools, skills and processes that a started agent can use. It is a list of suggestions in order of preference, not a set of limits. spawn.py puts the entries of a role into its prompt as one line each. The agent loads the full text of an entry only when it uses it. An entry whose locations are all absent on the machine is left out. The catalog holds only entries that each machine has. A file at ~/.config/herdr-skill/resources.json adds or replaces entries for one machine, for example a search MCP server or a desktop browser skill; resources.local.example.json shows such entries.

harness-web.title: Web tools of your harness
harness-web.use_when: The default for the web. When the machine file puts entries before this one, use it when they are not available or do not give the content.
harness-web.load: A search or fetch tool, a search MCP server, a browser MCP server, or `curl` for a page with a known URL.

local-search.title: Search in the working directory
local-search.use_when: First choice for a fact about the project.

local-machine.title: Other places on the machine
local-machine.use_when: When the answer is not in the working directory.
local-machine.load: Other directories, logs, session records and configuration.

local-services.title: Services that run
local-services.use_when: When files do not show the state.
local-services.load: Read-only commands such as `docker ps`, `docker logs`, or `curl` to a local endpoint.
